prompt: Generate a photorealistic image of a modern minimalist living room with the following furniture arrangement: One beige three-seater sofa positioned against the back wall. One rectangular wooden coffee table directly in front of the sofa. Two identical blue armchairs, one on each side of the coffee table, facing inward. One black floor lamp positioned to the right of the sofa. One green potted plant positioned to the left of the sofa. One large window on the left wall. Soft morning sunlight enters through the window from the left, illuminating the furniture and casting realistic, consistent shadows toward the right. Use a wide-angle, eye-level camera perspective. The room should have natural materials, realistic fabric textures, accurate furniture proportions, and a warm, inviting atmosphere. All furniture must be clearly visible. Do not include people, additional furniture, or text.
